note: 34 pages, 68 measured regions. Thirty numbered figures, three of them multi-panel blocks whose panels are measured separately (Figure 6 with 3, Figure 23 with 6, Figure 25 with 5, Figure 30 with 6 across the p32/p33 break), one unnumbered method flowchart on p24, three unnumbered body tables, and one key/value defaults grid that recurs on p21, p27 and p29 with no header row, recorded as table-as-figure because the table-grid block requires a header row these grids do not print. Figure 11 is a three-sketch sequence whose first sketch closes p12; it is counted once at the captioned region. The parameter list crosses the p3/p4 break and is counted once at p3. Display equations, the p27 sub-heading and both zoom fragments are excluded with reasons rather than dropped.
rules: a caption is quoted as the page sets it, so a bare printed label carries numbering Figure N and a label with a full stop carries Figure N. [caption.numbering]

a panel measured as its own region still carries the shared caption of its exhibit, so the panel count lives in [geometry.panel_count] and the shared caption in caption.verbatim rather than in eleven different caption strings. [geometry.panel_count]
an exhibit printed without any caption keeps caption_source none and zero caption.words instead of borrowing the nearest paragraph or heading. [caption.words]
a colour-field panel with no key is recorded as heatmap-or-contour and its missing key is stated by a false [geometry.colorbar], not by widening the family. [geometry.colorbar]
whether numeric ticks print decides if a crop is legible on its own, so it is recorded per exhibit in [geometry.printed_numbers]. [geometry.printed_numbers]
a legend is recorded only where a key box keys series, so the single in-frame key of Figure 29 panel (c) is inside and every other plot in this paper is none. [geometry.legend]

panels of one exhibit that sit on different pages keep their page in place and are ordered by [place.page_order] within the page, which is how the Figure 25 and Figure 30 blocks stay one exhibit across a page break. [place.page_order]

tables.note: header row Parameter / Parameter, then four body rows pairing a symbol with its meaning on each side: x,y,z; xdot,ydot,zdot; y',y''; z' on the left and s, E0, Eleave, Ereach on the right; the same grid continues on p4 with the force and energy symbols and no repeated header

analytical-versus-numerical comparison: header Condition, Method, Vy, Vertical Air, Fly Distance, Duration of Fly, then two groups of three rows, Without friction and With friction, each running Analytical, Numerical, Error Ratio with values such as 11.2316 m/s and a 0.083 percent error cell

plus-or-minus-ten-percent sensitivity grid: header cells +10%, Vertical Air Change Percentage, -10%, Vertical Air Change Percentage beside an empty corner, then one row per changed parameter W, H, B and Zt, each listing the perturbed value and the percentage change; the Extended Model heading begins just below
